title: Manchester derby without Guardiola: Carrick and Maresca face off
seoTitle: Manchester derby without Guardiola: Carrick vs Maresca
subtitle: Enzo Maresca debuts for City as Michael Carrick leads United in historic clash
excerpt: The Manchester derby, without Pep Guardiola for the first time in a decade, sees Enzo Maresca and Michael Carrick bring contrasting styles to the historic clash.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The derby between Manchester City and Manchester United arrives at Old Trafford without the presence of Pep Guardiola, who left the position at the end of last season. In place of the Catalan coach, City relies on Enzo Maresca, former assistant to Guardiola and former Chelsea coach, while United is led by Michael Carrick, who had already faced Maresca twice in the Championship.

What Changes in City's Playing Style Under Maresca

Inspired by his mentor Guardiola, Maresca opts for a rigid system, with players precisely positioned. The objective is to control ball possession, reduce uncertainty, and quickly execute trained actions. This fixed approach is reflected in the 3-2-5 or 3-1-3-3 formations that City typically adopt when in possession.

How Carrick Leads a More Fluid United

Unlike City, Carrick's United prioritizes tactical freedom. Although there are positioning guidelines, players can circulate freely, creating passing triangles and adapting to the moment of the match. This flexibility allows attackers like Fernandes or Cunha to move as needed, generating unpredictability for the opposing defense.

Head-to-Head Record Between the Managers

The first duel between Maresca and Carrick took place in November 2023, in the Championship, when Middlesbrough defeated Leicester 1-0 with a free-kick goal from Sam Greenwood. The second encounter, in February 2024, resulted in a 2-1 victory for Middlesbrough, with goals from Finn Azaz and Sam Silvera. Both matches were marked by many fouls and cards, highlighting the rivalry between the coaches.

Expectations for This Sunday's Derby

With City adopting a structured game plan and United maintaining a more chaotic style, the duel promises striking tactical contrasts. While City seeks the predictability of rehearsed movements, United relies on its players' ability to improvise and create spaces in midfield.

Season Implications

The result could influence the Premier League title race, as both clubs aim to reclaim the lead. Furthermore, the managers' performance could define the tactical direction each team will take in the coming weeks, whether reinforcing Maresca's discipline or consolidating Carrick's freedom.
